chatgpt.purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant: answers questions, explains topics, helps write and edit texts, and brainstorms ideas.
tasks: Explain a hard topic in plain words
Draft a letter or essay
Come up with names and ideas
chatgpt.prompt: Explain how photosynthesis works to an 8th grader. Use one everyday analogy and finish with three self-check questions.

claude.purpose: A chat assistant that handles long texts and documents well: reads them, summarises them and helps with wording.
tasks: Summarise a long document
Improve the structure of a text
Compare two versions of a sentence
claude.prompt:
Below is my presentation text. Suggest a clearer 5-part structure and point out which paragraphs can be shortened. Don't change my style.

[paste text]

gemini.purpose: Google's assistant. Works in the browser and in a mobile app and can be connected to Google services.
tasks: Plan a day or a trip
Find ideas for a project
Get to grips with a new topic
gemini.prompt: Make a 5-day plan to prepare for a history test, 40 minutes a day. Topic: [your topic]. Add a short self-test to each day.

copilot.purpose: Microsoft's assistant. Available in the browser and in Windows, and built into Microsoft 365 apps in some plans.
tasks: Word an email
Outline a document
Make sense of a spreadsheet or report
copilot.prompt: Help me write a polite email to my teacher asking to move my deadline by two days. Reason: [your reason]. No more than 80 words.

perplexity.purpose: Search with answers: it writes an answer to your question and shows links to sources you can open and check.
tasks: Find sources on a topic
Quickly compare facts from several sites
Build a reading list to verify
perplexity.prompt: What popular-science sources discuss how sleep affects memory? Give 5 sources with links and describe each in one sentence.

deepl.purpose: Translates texts and documents between many languages, and can suggest better wording for text you've written.
tasks: Translate an email or article
Compare translations of a phrase
Make foreign-language text sound more natural
deepl.prompt: Translate into Russian, keeping a formal tone: “Please confirm receipt of the documents by Friday.”

grammarly.purpose: Checks English writing for grammar, punctuation, clarity and tone, with suggestions as you type.
tasks: Proofread an English essay
Make a business email clearer
Find repetition and overly long sentences
grammarly.prompt: Make this paragraph clearer for a B1-level reader without changing the meaning: [paste paragraph]

midjourney.purpose: Creates images from text descriptions. Good for artistic illustrations, concepts and inspiration.
tasks: Illustrate a story
Explore a visual style for a project
Generate concept variations
midjourney.prompt: Watercolour illustration: a yurt at dawn on the steppe, soft warm light, mountains in the distance, lots of open sky, calm mood.

firefly.purpose: Adobe's image generation and editing. Some features are built into Photoshop and other Adobe apps.
tasks: Extend a photo's background
Create a texture or backdrop
Generate illustration variations
firefly.prompt: Flat vector illustration: a student at a desk with a laptop, calm green and beige colours, simple background.

canva.purpose: An online design editor with AI features for presentations, posters, social posts and image editing.
tasks: Make a poster or card quickly
Design a presentation
Remove a photo background
canva.prompt: Poster for a school robotics club: headline “Build your first robot”, date and place, minimal text, one bright accent colour.

runway.purpose: A set of AI video tools: generating short clips from text or images and helping with editing.
tasks: Animate a still image
Make a background or transition for a video
Try ideas for a clip
runway.prompt: Slow camera flight over snowy mountains at sunset, cinematic shot, no people, 5 seconds.

capcut.purpose: A video editor for phone and computer with automatic captions and other AI editing features.
tasks: Add captions to a video
Edit a short clip for social media
Pick an editing template
capcut.prompt: Editing plan: 3 scenes of 5 seconds each, a large caption in every scene, a call to subscribe at the end.

elevenlabs.purpose: Speech synthesis: reads text aloud in different voices and languages and helps with dubbing.
tasks: Voice a presentation or video
Listen to a text instead of reading it
Make an audio version of a lesson
elevenlabs.prompt: Read this text in a calm, friendly voice at a medium pace, with a pause after each paragraph: [text]

suno.purpose: Creates songs and music clips from a text description of genre, mood and theme.
tasks: Make a short tune for a video
Write a birthday song
Experiment with genres
suno.prompt: A cheerful acoustic song about the first day of the holidays, light rhythm, guitar and hand claps, no explicit lyrics.

github-copilot.purpose: An AI assistant in your code editor: suggests code, explains it and helps fix bugs.
tasks: Explain unfamiliar code
Write tests for a function
Find the cause of an error
github-copilot.prompt: Explain line by line what this function does and suggest two tests for edge cases: [paste code]

cursor.purpose: A code editor with built-in AI: ask questions about your project and request changes across several files.
tasks: Understand a project's structure
Make a small change in many files
Rewrite a function more clearly
cursor.prompt: Find where the project checks a user's login and explain the steps in plain words. Don't change the code yet.

notebooklm.purpose: Answers questions based on materials you upload (notes, articles, PDFs) and shows which passage it relies on.
tasks: Revise for an exam from your own notes
Summarise a set of articles
Find an answer in a long document
notebooklm.prompt: From my uploaded notes, write 10 self-check questions on chapter 3 and show where in the text each answer is.

gamma.purpose: Creates presentations, documents and simple web pages from a text description or an outline.
tasks: Draft a presentation from an outline
Lay out a report as a document
Show a project idea quickly
gamma.prompt: An 8-slide presentation “Saving water at home” for 6th grade: the problem, 5 simple tips, a summary and a question for the class.

notion-ai.purpose: AI inside the Notion workspace: helps write notes, summarise pages and search your own records.
tasks: Summarise a meeting
Turn notes into a task list
Find something in your notes
notion-ai.prompt: From these meeting notes, list the decisions, tasks with owners and deadlines in a table: [notes]

figma.purpose: An interface and website editor. Figma Make builds working prototypes and web apps from a description, and Figma Sites publishes responsive websites.
tasks: Lay out a page and check it on different screens
Build a clickable prototype from a description
Publish a prototype or site at a link
figma.prompt: Build a clickable prototype of a sign-up page for after-school clubs: a club list, a card with the schedule and an application form. Phone and desktop versions, no real data.

framer.purpose: A website builder with AI agents: it generates pages from a description, helps with copy and publishes the site with hosting.
tasks: Generate a landing-page draft from a description
Set up sections and a CMS for a blog
Publish the site on a free subdomain
framer.prompt: Create a one-page site for a school science club: what we do, upcoming meetings, how to join. A calm style, with no invented reviews or numbers.

tilda.purpose: A block-based website builder. Its AI assistant writes text for blocks and assembles a page from a description of the topic.
tasks: Assemble a page from ready-made blocks
Generate block text for the site's topic
Publish the site on a tilda.ws subdomain
tilda.prompt: Site topic: drawing classes for children aged 8–12 in Aktobe. Write a heading, a short description and three blocks: what they'll learn, how classes work, how to sign up. No prices or promises I haven't given.

v0.purpose: Vercel's generator for interfaces and web apps: it writes code from a description, shows a preview and publishes the project.
tasks: Generate a component or page from a description
Adjust the interface in a visual mode
Publish the project or connect it to GitHub
v0.prompt: Build a course catalogue page: cards with title, level and length, a level filter and a “nothing found” empty state. Responsive, with a clear keyboard focus.
